niche_preference_profile: This user most consistently prefers interfaces with clear visual hierarchy, generous spacing, rounded card-based structures, and strong focal separation. They often favor light neutral backgrounds with dark text and purple accents, especially when layouts feel calm, open, and modular. They like centered or tightly grouped content, concise but clearly structured information, visible section labels, and prominent primary actions. They also repeatedly prefer simplified, less cluttered presentations over dense or overly feature-stacked ones, while still valuing complete and well-organized content when it improves scannability.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers strong separation between headline, supporting text, sections, imagery, and actions, with obvious grouping and emphasis that makes the interface easy to scan.
Prefers generous padding, breathing room, spacious layouts, and fewer tightly packed elements on screen at once.
Prefers soft rounded corners on cards, buttons, and containers rather than sharper rectangular treatments.
Prefers contained card or modal layouts with clear sectional structure and modular blocks instead of long monolithic pages or flat full-page compositions.
Prefers visible, well-emphasized primary CTAs with clear contrast from secondary actions, often in rounded button treatments.
Usually prefers light neutral backgrounds, dark readable text, and soft purple accent branding over darker blue-heavy or muddier palettes.
Prefers cleaner, calmer interfaces with fewer decorative distractions, less competing chrome, and simpler visible information blocks.
